query:
insert into blobs (id, event_id, sha256, content_type, width_px, height_px, byte_size, data,
                              moderation_status, uploaded_by)
           select $1, $2, sha256, content_type, width_px, height_px, byte_size, data,
                  moderation_status, uploaded_by
           from blobs where id = $3
